advisories.title: CVE-2026-64849: MLflow Server-Side Request Forgery Vulnerability
advisories.summary: MLflow contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that can allow attackers to reach internal or cloud metadata services and receive response_status and response_body.

advisories.title: CVE-2025-62593: Ray-Project Ray Code Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Ray-Project Ray contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow remote code execution. Developers using Ray as a development tool may be exposed to this vulnerability exploitable through Firefox and Safari.
